english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for lively energy and enthusiasm.
This is the all-purpose choice for energy, vigour, or lively creative force.
Use this as the all-purpose choice for a person’s energy, vigour, or youthful vitality.
Use this for the all-purpose sense of liveliness or vivacity in a person, personality, or conversation.
Use this for the energy, vigour, or liveliness of a place or activity rather than a bodily beat.
Use this for a person’s or group’s energy, vitality, or spiritedness.
